nCROAS

Efficiency
ROAS

THE ROLE
Fitzpatrick and Heavey Homes is looking for a Digital Content & Social Media Specialist to own our day-to-day digital presence, planning, creating and publishing the content that tells the story of who we are and what we're building.
This is a hands-on, creative role.

You'll write copy, shoot and edit video and photography, manage our social channels, and help keep our website up to date.
Working closely with the Group Marketing Manager, you'll build relationships across sales, construction, design and leadership to source stories, keep a clear content calendar, and make sure our developments and milestones get the attention they deserve.
We're a young, fast-growing developer, so things move quickly.
This suits someone proactive and organised who's comfortable shaping their own way of working.
Prior experience in property or construction is a plus, but not essential.
What matters more is good judgement, strong creative instincts and initiative.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
 Manage our day-to-day presence across Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, TikTok and YouTube.
 Build and maintain a content calendar covering live developments, sales launches, construction milestones and company news.
 Spot content opportunities across the business, such as site progress, show home openings, sales events, planning approvals, groundbreakings, buyer handovers, team news and awards, and turn them into ideas worth publishing.
 Own content end to end: idea, capture, edit, caption, approval, scheduling and publishing.

 A practical grip on managing a website (CMS-based, e.g.
WordPress or Webflow) and basic SEO principles.
 A strong eye for design, including layout, typography, colour and brand consistency.
 Well organised, with the ability to run a content calendar and hit deadlines.
 Confident building relationships across the business and with external partners.
 Able to work independently, with the judgement to know when to check in or escalate.
 Sharp attention to detail: names, dates, specs and pricing all need to be right.
 A team player who's happy in a small, busy, fast-growing marketing team.

 Video capture and editing
 Photography and image editing.
 Copywriting for social, web and email.
